messages.content: You are MiniMax M2, an AI assistant developed by Minimax. You are a helpful assistant.

Run a duplicate therapy check for patient P-009417 using the medication list at /mnt/clinical/emr/patients/P-009417/med_list_v3.json. Flag duplicates at the RxNorm ingredient level, consider only active meds (ignore discontinued and on_hold), include OTC items, require the same route to count as a duplicate, and return a detailed JSON report.

function.name: flag_duplicate_therapies
function.description: Analyze a patient's medication list to identify potential duplicate therapies by ingredient or class. Supports RxNorm and ATC classification, status filtering, route matching, and OTC inclusion. Returns structured results.

med_list_path.description: Absolute file path to the medication list (JSON or CSV)

concurrency_window_days.description: If overlap_policy is date_overlap, the window in days to consider therapies overlapping (0 means exact date overlap)

strict_route_matching.description: Flag as duplicate only when routes match (e.g., oral vs inhalation)

include_otc.description: Include over-the-counter medications in the analysis

ignore_statuses.description: Medication statuses to exclude from analysis
